BloodLust.name: Frenzy
BloodLust.desc: When you down a unit, gain +2 STR.
BloodLust.desc2: When you down a unit, gain +2 STR and +2 SPD.

Avenger.name: Avenger
Avenger.desc: When an allied cat is downed, gain All Stats Up 2 and heal 8.
Avenger.desc2: When an allied cat is downed, gain All Stats Up 2, heal 50% of your max HP, and take an extra turn.

FasterWhenHit.name: Hulk Up
FasterWhenHit.desc: When you take damage, gain +2 SPD.
FasterWhenHit.desc2: When you take damage, gain +2 SPD and +10% dodge. This caps at 50%.

KillsHeal.name: Fervor
KillsHeal.desc: When you down a unit, you heal 5 HP.
KillsHeal.desc2: When you down a unit, you heal 50% of your HP.

Vengeful.name: Vengeful
Vengeful.desc: Your basic attack is always critical on enemies that have damaged you.
Vengeful.desc2:
Your basic attack is always critical on enemies units that have damaged you.
Inflict Marked on units that contact or attack you.

HamsterStyle.name: Hamster Style
HamsterStyle.desc:
+1 Health Regeneration.
Start with 2 Bonus Moves.
HamsterStyle.desc2:
+2 Health Regeneration.
Start with 2 Bonus Moves.
Your basic attack has a chance to attack multiple times.

WeaponMaster.name: Weapon Master
WeaponMaster.desc: Your weapon and item abilities deal +2 Damage and get +25% critical chance. A pipe is added to your inventory.
WeaponMaster.desc2:
Your weapon and item abilities deal +3 Damage and get +50% critical chance.
If you don't have a weapon, gain a random temporary weapon at the beginning of the battle.

ShoulderCheck.name: Shoulder Check
ShoulderCheck.desc: If you're facing a unit after you move, automatically attack it at 33% damage.
ShoulderCheck.desc2: If you're facing a unit after you move, automatically attack the unit.

Overpowered.name: OVERPOWERED!!!
Overpowered.desc: Excess damage you deal to units makes them explode, dealing the excess damage to units around it, except for you.
Overpowered.desc2: Excess damage you deal to units makes them explode, dealing the excess damage to units within 2 tiles of it, except for you.

FightMe.name: Underdog
FightMe.desc: You have +2 STR and +1 Brace for each enemy adjacent to you.
FightMe.desc2: You have +3 STR and +2 Brace for each enemy adjacent to you.

HighAsYouCanCount.name: Math?
HighAsYouCanCount.desc: Your spells cost 3 mana to cast, but each can be cast only once per turn.
HighAsYouCanCount.desc2: Your spells cost 0 mana to cast, but each can be cast only once per turn.

DumbMuscle.name: Dumb Muscle
DumbMuscle.desc:
Lose 1 INT each time you take damage.
If you have 4 or less INT, gain +2 STR and your basic attack inflicts Bruise. at 0 INT, gain +100% critical hit chance.
DumbMuscle.desc2:
Lose 2 INT each time you take damage.
If you have 4 or less INT, gain +2 STR and your basic attack inflicts Bruise. At 0 INT, gain +100% critical hit chance. At -10 INT, you can use your basic move and attack an additional time each turn.

ThickSkull.name: Thick Skull
ThickSkull.desc:
All injuries you get are Concussions.
You get +3 Shield for each concussion you have. This caps at 30 Shield.
ThickSkull.desc2:
All injuries you get are Concussions.
You get +3 Shield and +1 STR for each concussion you have. This caps at 30 Shield and 10 STR.

MostValuableCat.name: Most Valuable Cat
MostValuableCat.desc:
When you or an ally downs another unit, they become the Alpha.
If you're the Alpha, take an extra turn at the end of each round.
MostValuableCat.desc2:
You start the battle as the Alpha.
Whenever you or an ally downs another unit, they become the Alpha.
If you're the Alpha, take an extra turn at the end of each round.

Boned.name: Boned
Boned.desc: When you kill a unit, if you don't have a weapon, gain a Bone Club.
Boned.desc2:
When you kill a unit, if you don't have a weapon, gain a Bone Club.
Bonus Ability: Throw Weapon.

DualWield.name: Dual Wield
DualWield.desc: When you use your weapon, automatically use it again for free.
DualWield.desc2: When you use your weapon, automatically use it again for free, and then again! for free!

ReflexPunch.name: Patellar Reflex
ReflexPunch.desc: When a unit damages you, counter-attack dealing 1 damage and inflicting Bruise.
ReflexPunch.desc2: When a unit damages you, counter-attack with your basic attack and inflict Bruise.

HitMe.name: Hit Me
HitMe.desc:
When you take damage from an ally, basic attack in the direction you're facing.
Damage you take from allies is reduced to 1.
HitMe.desc2:
When you take damage from an ally, basic attack in the direction you're facing.
Damage you take from allies is reduced to 1.
Whenever you take damage, gain +1 to a random stat.

Smash.name: Smash!
Smash.desc:
Your weapons deal triple damage, but they always break when you use them.
Three Sticks are added to your inventory.
Smash.desc2:
Your weapons deal triple damage, but they have a 50% chance to break when you use them.
Three more Sticks are added to your inventory.

PunchFace.name: Punch Face
PunchFace.desc: Your basic attacks are critical if they hit the front of a unit.
PunchFace.desc2: Your physical attacks are critical if they hit the front of a unit.

Recoil.name: Merciless
Recoil.desc:
When you deal 10 or more damage in a single hit, gain +2 Shield and refresh your movement action.
(This doesn't trigger during your movement action.)
Recoil.desc2:
When you deal 10 or more damage in a single hit, gain +2 Shield, All Stats Up, and refresh your movement action.
(This doesn't trigger during your movement action.)

Micronaps.name: Synthesize
Micronaps.desc: Gain +1 INT at the start of each turn.
Micronaps.desc2:
Gain +1 INT at the start of each turn.
Your spells cost 25% less mana.

HolyMantel.name: Force Field
HolyMantel.desc: At the start of every third turn, gain +1 DIVINESHIELD.
HolyMantel.desc2: At the start of every other turn, gain +1 DIVINESHIELD.

Shrapnel.name: Splash Damage
Shrapnel.desc: Your basic attack deals 2 Magic splash damage.
Shrapnel.desc2: +2 Range. Your basic attack deals 2 Magic splash damage in a wide area.

LightningPaws.name: Lightning Paws
LightningPaws.desc: Your basic attack deals +2 Electric Damage and has a 15% chance to Stun.
LightningPaws.desc2: Your basic attack deals +4 Electric Damage and has a 40% chance to Stun.

IcePaws.name: Ice Paws
IcePaws.desc: Your basic attack deals Ice Damage, inflicts Slow 2, and has a 20% chance to Freeze. You can damage frozen units.
IcePaws.desc2: Your basic attack deals Ice Damage, inflicts Slow 5, and has a 50% chance to Freeze. You can damage frozen units.

PawMissile.name: Paw Missile
PawMissile.desc:
Your basic attack is Magic Missile.
(its damage scales with INT).
PawMissile.desc2:
Your basic attack is Magic Missile.
(its damage scales with INT).
Emit 4 Sparkles when you use your basic attack.

Overload.name: Overload
Overload.desc: When you cast a spell, deal 3 random elemental damage to adjacent tiles.
Overload.desc2: When you cast a spell, deal 6 tri-elemental damage to adjacent tiles.

ChargeUp.name: Charge Up
ChargeUp.desc: If you end your turn with 0 mana, the next spell you cast is free
ChargeUp.desc2: If you end your turn with 0 mana, gain +1 Magic Damage and the next spell you cast is free.

DeathChill.name: Death Chill
DeathChill.desc: When downed, Freeze all enemies and the rest of the map.
DeathChill.desc2: When downed, Freeze all enemies and the rest of the map, and full heal all allies.

Recharged.name: Epiphany
Recharged.desc:
+5 starting mana. +5 Mana Regeneration.
Lose all unspent mana at the end of each of your turns
Recharged.desc2:
+20 starting mana. +5 Mana Regeneration.
Lose all unspent mana at the end of each of your turns

EnergyStorm.name: Three
EnergyStorm.desc: Every 3rd spell you cast in a turn is cast twice.
EnergyStorm.desc2: The first spell and every 3rd spell you cast is cast twice.

FireArmor.name: Fire Aspect
FireArmor.desc:
Fire immunity.
Inflict Burn 1 on units that contact you.
Your Fire element damage is increased by 1 and inflicts +1 Burn.
FireArmor.desc2:
Fire immunity.
Inflict Burn 3 on units that contact you.
Your Fire element damage is increased by 2 and inflicts +3 Burn.

IceArmor.name: Ice Aspect
IceArmor.desc:
Ice immunity. You can damage frozen units.
Units that contact you take 1 Ice Damage, Slow 2, and have a 5% chance to Freeze.
IceArmor.desc2:
+2 Brace. Ice immunity. You can damage frozen units.
Units that contact you take 3 Ice Damage, Slow 2, and have a 15% chance to Freeze.

Resonance.name: Resonance
Resonance.desc: When you cast a spell gain +1 Magic Damage for the rest of the turn.
Resonance.desc2: When you cast a spell gain +1 Magic Damage and +1 Damage for the rest of the turn.

LearnFromMe.name: Learn From Me
LearnFromMe.desc: When you cast a spell, all allied cats gain that spell in their bonus slot.
LearnFromMe.desc2: When you cast a spell, all allied cats gain the upgraded version of that spell in their bonus slot.

LightningArmor.name: Lightning Aspect
LightningArmor.desc:
Electric immunity.
When you deal Electric Damage, gain +1 Charge.
LightningArmor.desc2:
Electric immunity.
When you deal Electric Damage, gain +1 Charge for each point of damage dealt.

LongCast.name: Long Cast
LongCast.desc2: +2 Magic Damage. Tile-targeted spells gain +10 Range.

LightUpTheStage.name: Light Up the Stage
LightUpTheStage.desc: At the end of your turn, emit 2 Sparkles for each turn you've taken.
LightUpTheStage.desc2: At the end of your turn, emit 4 Sparkles for each turn you've taken and gain +1 Kinetic Spikes .

ElementalAttunement.name: Elemental Attunement
ElementalAttunement.desc: Casting elemental spells imbues your basic attack with those elements and relevant effects for the rest of the battle.
ElementalAttunement.desc2:
Casting elemental spells imbues your basic attack with those elements and relevant effects for the rest of the battle.
Elemental spells cost -2 mana.

LatentEnergy.name: Latent Energy
LatentEnergy.desc: When an ally spends mana, Gain +2 Magic Damage until the next time you use magic.
LatentEnergy.desc2: When an ally spends mana, Gain +2 Magic Damage until the next time you use magic, and gain +2 mana.

Five.name: Five
Five.desc: When you end your turn with exactly 5 mana or HP, gain +5 Shield and temporarily gain +5 Kinetic Spikes until the end of your next turn .
Five.desc2: When you end your turn with exactly 5 mana or HP, gain +5 Shield, heal 5 HP and temporarily gain +5 Kinetic Spikes and +5 Damage until the end of your next turn.

MagicGuru.name: Magic Guru
MagicGuru.desc: Your allies have +1 Mana Regeneration. When an ally spends 7+ mana to cast a spell, they gain All Stats Up.
MagicGuru.desc2: Your allies have +1 Mana Regeneration. When an ally spends 7+ mana to cast a spell, they gain All Stats Up. When you spend mana, each ally gains +1 mana.

One.name: One
One.desc: When you end your turn, if you cast exactly 1 spell, double cast your next spell.
One.desc2: When you end your turn, if you cast exactly 1 spell, double cast your next 2 spells.

Two.name: Two
Two.desc:
When you end your turn, if you cast exactly 2 spells, gain +1 Bonus Attack.
When you end your turn, if you have exactly 2 mana, gain +1 Bonus Attack.
Two.desc2:
When you end your turn, if you cast exactly 2 spells, gain +1 Bonus Attack and Movement.
When you end your turn, if you have exactly 2 mana, gain +1 Bonus Attack and Movement.

Four.name: Four
Four.desc: When you end your turn with exactly 4 mana or HP, gain +1 INT and +1 Magic Damage.
Four.desc2: When you end your turn with exactly 4 mana or HP, gain +1 INT, +1 Magic Damage, +1 Kinetic Spikes, and +1 Holy Shield.

HealingAura.name: Healing Aura
HealingAura.desc:
+1 Health Regeneration
Your Health Regeneration also applies to your allies.
HealingAura.desc2:
+2 Health Regeneration
Your Health Regeneration also applies to your allies.
You and your allies have uncapped HP.

NaturalHealer.name: Natural Healer
NaturalHealer.desc2:
Your heals heal for 4 extra.
Start each battle at full HP.

Eternal.name: Eternal
Eternal.desc: When you are downed for the 1st time each battle, take no injuries and revive with half HP.
Eternal.desc2: When you are downed for the 1st time each battle, take no injuries and revive with half HP, All Stats Up 2, and immediately take an extra turn.

Blessed.name: Blessed
Blessed.desc: Gain +1 to 2 random stats at the start of each turn.
Blessed.desc2: +3 Health Regeneration Gain +1 to 3 random stats at the start of each turn.

EvilPatron.name: Evil Patron
EvilPatron.desc:
Your healing abilities deal damage to enemies.
Gain +2 range on tile-targeted healing spells.
EvilPatron.desc2:
Your healing abilities deal damage to enemies.
Holy element damage you deal is doubled.
Gain +2 range on tile-targeted healing spells.

AngelicInspiration.name: Angelic Inspiration
AngelicInspiration.desc: When you heal an ally, they also gain +2 mana.
AngelicInspiration.desc2: When you heal an ally, they also gain mana equal to half the amount healed.

TopOff.name: Top Off
TopOff.desc: When you heal another unit over their max HP, you both gain +1 Shield.
TopOff.desc2: When you heal another unit over their max HP, you both gain +2 Shield.

SharingIsCaring.name: Sharing is Caring
SharingIsCaring.desc: When you pick up a non-coin pickup, allies gain the same effects.
SharingIsCaring.desc2:
When you pick up a non-coin pickup, allies gain the same effects.
Start each battle with pickups nearby.

Caretaker.name: Caretaker
Caretaker.desc: When you heal another unit, heal yourself for half that amount.
Caretaker.desc2: When you heal another unit, heal yourself for the same amount.

MoraleBoost.name: Morale Boost
MoraleBoost.desc: Allies gain All Stats Up whenever you kill something.
MoraleBoost.desc2:
Allies gain All Stats Up whenever you kill something.
When you kill something, refresh your basic attack.

RangedMedic.name: Ranged Medic
RangedMedic.desc: Your basic attack is a ranged lobbed attack that heals allies and damages enemies.
RangedMedic.desc2: +2 Range. Your basic attack is a ranged lobbed attack that heals allies and damages enemies.

Godspeed.name: Godspeed
Godspeed.desc: When you heal something, gain +2 SPD.
Godspeed.desc2: When you heal something, gain +4 SPD and +1 to a random stat.

GodWarrior.name: God Warrior
GodWarrior.desc: When you kill an enemy, gain +1 DIVINESHIELD.
GodWarrior.desc2: When you kill an enemy, gain +1 DIVINESHIELD and refresh your movement action.

BreathOfLife.name: Breath of Life
BreathOfLife.desc: When you heal a downed unit, revive it.
BreathOfLife.desc2: When you heal a downed unit, revive it and heal it for 3 times the number you healed.

ThouShaltNotKill.name: Thou Shalt Not Kill
ThouShaltNotKill.desc: When an enemy downs another unit, they take 10 holy damage.
ThouShaltNotKill.desc2: When an enemy downs another unit, they take 10 holy damage and become Stunned.

ThouShaltNotCovet.name: Thou Shalt Not Covet
ThouShaltNotCovet.desc: When an enemy takes damage from an ability, it drops a random pickup.
ThouShaltNotCovet.desc2: When an enemy takes damage from an ability, it drops 2 random pickups.

BlessingOfHolyFire.name: Blessing of Holy Fire
BlessingOfHolyFire.desc:
Holy-element spells deal double damage to enemies instead of healing and inflict Burn 2. 
This blessing is lost when you kill a unit.
BlessingOfHolyFire.desc2:
Holy-element spells deal triple damage to enemies instead of healing and inflict Burn 3. 
This blessing is lost when you kill a unit.

AlmsForThePoor.name: Alms for the Poor
AlmsForThePoor.desc: When you gain coins, all allies heal +1 HP and gain +1 LUCK.
AlmsForThePoor.desc2: When you gain coins, you gain +1 DIVINESHIELD and all allies heal HP and gain LUCK equal to the number of coins gained.

Purifier.name: Purifier
Purifier.desc: Your basic attack removes debuffs from allies.
Purifier.desc2: Your basic attack removes debuffs from allies and gives them All Stats Up.

VeneratedTouch.name: Venerated Touch
VeneratedTouch.desc: Your basic attack inflicts Confusion 2 on enemies and gives +2 Shield to allies.
VeneratedTouch.desc2: Your basic attack inflicts Confusion 3 on enemies and has a 50% chance to Stun. It also gives +3 Shield to allies and a 50% chance for All Stats Up.

ProtectTheWeak.name: Protect the Weak
ProtectTheWeak.desc: Allies with 5 or fewer HP gain +50% dodge chance.
ProtectTheWeak.desc2: Allies with 10 or fewer HP gain +50% dodge chance.

ThouShaltObey.name: Thou Shalt Obey
ThouShaltObey.desc: At the end of each round, inflict Charm on a random adjacent enemy.
ThouShaltObey.desc2: At the end of each round, inflict Charm on the closest enemy.

EnchantedRelic.name: Enchanted Relic
EnchantedRelic.desc: Your trinket's passive and active effects are doubled.
EnchantedRelic.desc2: Your trinket's passive and active effects are tripled.

BlessingOfSpirit.name: Blessing of Spirit
BlessingOfSpirit.desc: When you end your turn, you and all allies heal 2 HP and gain 2 mana. This blessing is lost when you cast a spell.
BlessingOfSpirit.desc2: When you end your turn, you and all allies heal 3 HP, gain 3 mana and gain +1 to 3 random stats. This blessing is lost when you cast a spell.

Heathens.name: Heathens!
Heathens.desc: At the start of the battle, inflict Weakness 3 on all enemies.
Heathens.desc2: At the start of the battle, inflict Weakness 4 and Magic Weakness 4 on all enemies.

Backstabber.name: Backstabber
Backstabber.desc2:
Your backstabs are always critical.
When you land a critical hit, gain a random stat up.

GoldenClaws.name: Golden Claws
GoldenClaws.desc: Gain +1 Damage for each coin you collect.
GoldenClaws.desc2: Gain +2 Damage for each coin you collect.

Shadow.name: Stealthed
Shadow.desc2: Start each battle with Stealth. Gain Stealth when you get a kill.

PoisonTips.name: Poison Tips
PoisonTips.desc2:
Your basic attack inflicts Poison 1.
Poison you inflict is doubled.

Burgle.name: Burgle
Burgle.desc: Your basic attack gains you 1 coin when it deals damage.
Burgle.desc2: Your basic attack gains you 1 coin and spawns a coin pickup when it deals damage.

SwiftKiller.name: More!
SwiftKiller.desc: When you kill a unit, refresh your movement action.
SwiftKiller.desc2: When you kill a unit, refresh your movement and basic attack.

DoubleThrow.name: Double Throw
DoubleThrow.desc: Your basic attack hits twice for half damage.
DoubleThrow.desc2: Your basic attack hits thrice for 1/3rd damage.

BountyHunter.name: Bounty Hunter
BountyHunter.desc: During your turn, one random enemy has a Bounty.
BountyHunter.desc2: During your turn, 2 random enemies have a large Bounty.

RazorClaws.name: Razor Claws
RazorClaws.desc2: All of your damaging abilities inflict Bleed 1.

Looter.name: Swift Looter
Looter.desc:
When you collect a coin pickup, refresh your movement action.
1-2 extra coins spawn in each battle.
Looter.desc2:
When you collect a coin pickup, refresh your movement action and gain +1 DEX and +1 SPD.
2-3 extra coins spawn in each battle.

AlphaStrike.name: First Strike
AlphaStrike.desc: Gain an extra turn at the start of the battle.
AlphaStrike.desc2: Gain an extra turn at the start of the battle. Damage you deal on this turn is always critical.

Zip.name: ZIP!
Zip.desc2:
Your movement action is Shadowstep.
You can use your movement action an extra time each turn.

WeakSpot.name: Weak Spot
WeakSpot.desc: Your basic attack ignores shield and inflicts Weakness 1.
WeakSpot.desc2: All of your damaging abilities ignore shield and inflict Weakness 2. +25% crit chance.

Penetrate.name: Penetrate
Penetrate.desc: Your basic attack passes through units and ignores shield. +1 Range.
Penetrate.desc2: Your basic attack passes through units and ignores shield. +10 Range.

AfterImage.name: After Image
AfterImage.desc: When you move, spawn a shadow where you moved from. The shadow mimics your basic action but fades away at the end of your turn.
AfterImage.desc2: When you move, spawn a shadow where you moved from. The shadow mimics your basic action.

Shiv.name: Shiv
Shiv.desc: Your basic attack has +2 damage, +25% critical chance, and inflicts Bleed 1 when attacking a unit in melee range.
Shiv.desc2: Your basic attack has +2 damage, +50% critical chance, and inflicts Bleed 2 when attacking a unit in melee range.

Critical.name: Critical
Critical.desc: Your critical hits deal +100% more damage. Gain +1 LUCK whenever you make a critical hit.
Critical.desc2: Your critical hits deal +100% more damage and inflict Bleed and Weakness 1. Gain +1 LUCK whenever you make a critical hit.

LootHoarder.name: Loot Hoarder
LootHoarder.desc: Automatically collect all pickups at the end of the battle if you're not downed.
LootHoarder.desc2: Automatically destroy all enemy bodies and collect all pickups at the end of the battle if you're not downed.

Cripple.name: Cripple
Cripple.desc: Your critical hits inflict Immobilize and Weakness 2.
Cripple.desc2: Your critical hits inflict Stun and Weakness 2.

Agile.name: Agile
Agile.desc: +2 Movement Range. If you move fewer tiles than your full movement range, you can move a 2nd time for the rest of your movement range.
Agile.desc2: +4 Movement Range. If you move fewer tiles than your full movement range, you can move a 2nd, 3rd and 4th time for the rest of your movement range.

Shank.name: Shank
Shank.desc: When behind and adjacent to an enemy, your basic attack is a melee attack that hits twice.
Shank.desc2: When behind and adjacent to an enemy, your basic attack is a melee attack that hits thrice!

FlipACoin.name: Flip a Coin
FlipACoin.desc: When you gain a coin, you have a 50% chance to spawn a coin on a random tile and a 50% chance to gain +2 SPD and +2 LUCK.
FlipACoin.desc2: When you gain a coin, you have a 50% chance to spawn 2 coins on random tiles and a 50% chance to gain +2 SPD, +2 LUCK and +2 DEX.

ShakeDown.name: Shake Down
ShakeDown.desc: Your critical hits spawn a coin and a random pickup.
ShakeDown.desc2: +25% critical hit chance. Your critical hits spawn a coin and two random pickups.

SweetSpot.name: Sweetspot
SweetSpot.desc: +1 Range. Your basic attack deals more damage the farther away you are from the target.
SweetSpot.desc2: +6 Range. Your basic attack deals more damage the farther away you are from the target.

Pinpoint.name: Pinpoint
Pinpoint.desc2:
Your critical hits inflict Marked.
Your critical hits deal 100% more damage.

SafeSwitching.name: Safe Switching
SafeSwitching.desc: When you switch stances, gain +2 Shield.
SafeSwitching.desc2: When you switch stances, gain +3 Shield and cleanse one stack of a random debuff.

Mixup.name: Mixup
Mixup.desc: When you switch stances, your next basic attack this turn is critical.
Mixup.desc2:
When you switch stances, your next basic attack this turn is critical.
Critical hits you land inflict Confusion 1.

Turnabout.name: Turnabout
Turnabout.desc: Your basic melee attacks inflict Confusion 1 and make units face away from you.
Turnabout.desc2: Your basic melee attacks inflict Confusion 1, make units face away from you, and have a 20% chance to inflict Stun 1.

MonkeyStyle.name: Monkey Style
MonkeyStyle.desc: 15% chance to block damage and counter-attack.
MonkeyStyle.desc2: 33% chance to block damage and counter-attack.

BrickSkin.name: Brick Skin
BrickSkin.desc: Any Shield you gain is increased by 2.
BrickSkin.desc2: Any Shield you gain is increased by 2.

JaggedEdges.name: Jagged Edges
JaggedEdges.desc: When you lose Shield, gain +1 Thorns.
JaggedEdges.desc2: When you lose Shield, gain that many Thorns.

MindBreaker.name: Mind Breaker
MindBreaker.desc: Your basic attack inflicts Magic Weakness 1.
MindBreaker.desc2: Your basic attack inflicts Magic Weakness 2.

CobraStyle.name: Cobra Style
CobraStyle.desc: When an enemy moves into an adjacent tile, perform a weak melee attack on it.
CobraStyle.desc2: When an enemy moves into an adjacent tile, perform a weak melee attack on it, twice!

Tenderize.name: Tenderize
Tenderize.desc: Your basic melee attacks inflict Bruise 1.
Tenderize.desc2: Your basic melee attacks inflict Bruise 1 and have a 15% chance to inflict Stun 1.

SpreadThePain.name: Spread the Pain
SpreadThePain.desc: Deal 2 extra damage the first time you damage each unit each turn.
SpreadThePain.desc2: Deal 2 extra damage with 100% crit chance the first time you damage each unit each turn.

Harden.name: Harden
Harden.desc: When you gain Shield, also gain temporary Brace 1.
Harden.desc2:
When you gain Shield, also gain temporary Brace 1.
Gain +1 Shield when you hit a unit with your basic attack.

IronSkin.name: Iron Skin Technique
IronSkin.desc: Gain +2 Shield when you land a critical hit. +10% critical chance.
IronSkin.desc2: Gain +3 Shield when you land a critical hit. +25% critical chance.

JetFists.name: Jet Fists
JetFists.desc: Your melee attacks and abilities blow wind through the tiles they hit.
JetFists.desc2: Your melee attacks and abilities blow wind through the tiles they hit in a large cone.

EnergyFists.name: Energy Fists
EnergyFists.desc: Emit a Sparkle when you use your basic attack.
EnergyFists.desc2: Emit two Sparkles when you use your basic attack.

Unstoppable.name: Unstoppable!
Unstoppable.desc: You're immune to knockback, Stun, Slow, and other mobility debuffs.
Unstoppable.desc2: You're immune to knockback and debuffs.

UnburdenedMotion.name: Unburdened Motion
UnburdenedMotion.desc: +1 SPD and +10% dodge chance for each empty armor slot. If all of your armor slots are empty, you can use your movement action an extra time.
UnburdenedMotion.desc2: +2 SPD and +15% dodge chance for each empty armor slot. If all of your armor slots are empty, you gain flying and can use your movement action an extra time.

UnburdenedStrikes.name: Unburdened Strikes
UnburdenedStrikes.desc: +10% critical hit chance and +25% critical hit damage for each empty armor slot. If all of your armor slots are empty, counter-attack whenever you get hit.
UnburdenedStrikes.desc2: +10% critical hit chance and +25% critical hit damage for each empty armor slot. If all of your armor slots are empty your critical hits inflict bruise, and counter-attack whenever you get hit.

UnburdenedThoughts.name: Unburdened Thoughts
UnburdenedThoughts.desc: +1 INT and +1 CHA for each empty armor slot. If all of your armor slots are empty, your spells cost 1 less mana.
UnburdenedThoughts.desc2: +1 INT, +1 CHA, and +1 Kinetic Spikes for each empty armor slot. If all of your armor slots are empty, you have +2 Magic Damage and your spells cost 1 less mana.

RunningJab.name: Running Jab
RunningJab.desc: When you end your movement, automatically use your basic attack if an enemy is in range.
RunningJab.desc2: When you end your movement, automatically use your basic attack if an enemy is in range. You can move an extra time each turn.

PerfectTechnique.name: Perfect Technique
PerfectTechnique.desc: While in ranged stance, You have +1 Range and +2 Magic Damage. While in melee stance, you have +1 Brace.
PerfectTechnique.desc2: While in ranged stance, You have +1 Range, +2 Kinetic Spikes, and +2 Magic Damage. While in melee stance, you have +2 Brace and +2 Health Regeneration.

RapidFlow.name: Rapid Flow
RapidFlow.desc: When you switch stances, do a spin attack that hits all adjacent units.
RapidFlow.desc2: When you switch stances, do a double spin attack that hits all adjacent units.

CounterBarrage.name: Counter Barrage
CounterBarrage.desc: When you take damage from an enemy attack, gain +1 Bonus Attack.
CounterBarrage.desc2: When you take damage from an enemy attack, gain +1 Bonus Attack and +1 Bonus Move.

FlowState.name: Flow State
FlowState.desc: When you deal damage to another unit, gain +1 STR and +2 DEX until the end of the turn.
FlowState.desc2: When you deal damage to another unit, gain +2 STR, +2 DEX, and +2 LUCK until the end of the turn.

DancingLights.name: Dancing Lights
DancingLights.desc: When you switch stances, for each empty armor slot, emit a Sparkle. If all slots are empty gain +1 to a random stat.
DancingLights.desc2:
When you switch stances, for each empty armor slot, emit a Sparkle. If all slots are empty gain +1 to a random stat.
While all armor slots are empty, you have +1 Magic Damage.

VersionTwo.name: v2.0
VersionTwo.desc:
Start with 1 Tech.
Your Tech can't drop below 1.
VersionTwo.desc2:
Start with 1 Tech.
Your Tech can't drop below 1.
Your Tech isn't removed when you craft.

WeaponProficiency.name: Weapon Proficiency
WeaponProficiency.desc: Your weapon damage scales with your stats and counts as a basic attack.
WeaponProficiency.desc2:
Your weapon damage scales with your stats and counts as a basic attack.
You can use your weapon an extra time each turn.

LivingBattery.name: Living Battery
LivingBattery.desc: When an adjacent ally spends mana, gain that much mana.
LivingBattery.desc2: When an adjacent ally spends mana, gain that much mana. You have no mana cap.

FuzzyFeet.name: Fuzzy Feet
FuzzyFeet.desc: When you end your movement, deal 1 Electric Damage to all adjacent units for each tile you moved.
FuzzyFeet.desc2: When you end your movement, deal 1 Electric Damage to all adjacent units for each tile you moved. This damage has a chance to inflict Stun.

ArmorSpecialist.name: Armor Specialist
ArmorSpecialist.desc: Your equipment passive effects are doubled.
ArmorSpecialist.desc2: Your equipment passive and active effects are doubled.

EMP.name: EMP
EMP.desc:
Your explosions are Electric element and deal +2 damage.
Instead of knockback, explosions have a chance to inflict Stun.
+2 Blast Resistance.
EMP.desc2:
Your explosions are Electric element and deal +4 damage.
Instead of knockback, explosions have a chance to inflict Stun. Your explosions don't affect allies.
+4 Blast Resistance.

MrMega.name: Mr. Mega
MrMega.desc:
Your explosions are larger and deal +3 damage.
+3 Blast Resistance.
MrMega.desc2:
Your explosions are larger and deal +6 damage.
You have explosion immunity.

EscapeSequence.name: Escape Sequence
EscapeSequence.desc: When you take damage, explode and get launched to a random tile. This explosion doesn't damage you.
EscapeSequence.desc2: When you take damage, explode with a large blast radius and get launched to a random tile. This explosion doesn't damage you.

ItemProxy.name: Item Proxy
ItemProxy.desc: You need one fewer piece of equipment to get set bonuses.
ItemProxy.desc2: You need two fewer pieces of equipment to get set bonuses.

LightningRod.name: Lightning Rod
LightningRod.desc:
You have Electric immunity and are conductive.
Electric damage you deal is increased by 1. Gain 1 Tech when you are hit with electric damage.
LightningRod.desc2:
You have Electric immunity and are conductive.
Electric damage you deal is increased by 2. Gain 1 Tech and become Energized when you are hit with electric damage.

ItsAlive.name: IT'S ALIVE!
ItsAlive.desc: Hitting a body with electric damage revives it with 1 HP. The revived corpse is charmed and takes an extra turn, then dies.
ItsAlive.desc2: Hitting a body with electric damage revives it with 1 HP, +8 SPD, and +2 Damage. The revived corpse is charmed and takes an extra turn, then dies.

Energizer.name: Energizer
Energizer.desc: When you cast a spell, your weapon gets +1 Damage.
Energizer.desc2:
When you cast a spell, your weapon gets +1 Damage.
Every third spell you cast, repair 1 use to your weapon.

ReactiveArmor.name: Reactive Armor
ReactiveArmor.desc: When you take damage, craft a Tinkerer weapon or armor piece and equip it in an empty slot.
ReactiveArmor.desc2: When you take damage, craft a Tinkerer weapon or armor piece and equip it in an empty slot and gain +1 Shield.

Nanobots.name: Nanobots
Nanobots.desc: Gain +2 Diminishing Health Regeneration every time you take damage from an attack or spell.
Nanobots.desc2: Gain +2 Diminishing Health Regeneration every time you take damage from an attack or spell and +1 Diminishing Health Regeneration each time you take damage from any other source.

Scrapper.name: Scrapper
Scrapper.desc:
Find an extra consumable item at the end of each battle.
When you use up a consumable or trinket, equip a new consumable from your inventory if you have any.
Scrapper.desc2:
Find an extra item at the end of each battle.
When you use up a consumable or trinket, equip a new consumable from your inventory if you have any.

DemoMan.name: Demo Man
DemoMan.desc:
Always craft a bomb at Tech 1 or less.
+2 Blast Resistance.
DemoMan.desc2:
Always craft a bomb at Tech 1 or less. You can use your basic action an additional time on each of your turns.
+3 Blast Resistance.

DuctTape.name: Duct Tape
DuctTape.desc: Items you craft stay with you between battles, but become cursed.
DuctTape.desc2: Items you craft stay with you between battles.

ArmoredPlating.name: Armored Plating
ArmoredPlating.desc: Robots you spawn gain the stats and Shield of your equipped armor.
ArmoredPlating.desc2: Robots you spawn gain the stats, Shield and passive effects of your equipped armor.

BoobyTrap.name: Booby Trap
BoobyTrap.desc: When an item you have equipped breaks, it explodes!
BoobyTrap.desc2: When an item you have equipped breaks, it explodes with bonus damage!

RobotArms.name: Robot Arms
RobotArms.desc: You can use your weapon an additional time each turn.
RobotArms.desc2:
You can use your weapon and trinket an additional time each turn.
Whenever you equip a new item during battle it gains +1 use.

Conductor.name: Conductor
Conductor.desc:
Electric damage you deal is increased by 2 for each piece of metal armor you have equipped.
If you are wearing metal, your weapon deals electric damage.
Conductor.desc2:
Electric damage you deal is increased by 2 for each piece of metal armor you have equipped. You have +2 Mana Regeneration for each piece of metal armor.
If you are wearing metal, your weapon deals electric damage.

Napalm.name: Napalm
Napalm.desc:
Your explosions inflict Burn 3 and light tiles on fire.
+2 Blast Resistance.
Napalm.desc2:
Your explosions inflict Burn 6 and light tiles on fire.
+3 Blast Resistance.

Ingenuity.name: Ingenuity
Ingenuity.desc: Pickups give you +1 Tech in addition to their other effects.
Ingenuity.desc2:
Pickups give you +1 Tech in addition to their other effects.
10 extra pickups spawn at the start of each battle.

Shrapnel_Tinkerer.name: Shrapnel
Shrapnel_Tinkerer.desc: When you break an item, gain +1 Thorns.
Shrapnel_Tinkerer.desc2: When you break an item, gain +2 Thorns and +3 Shield.

Blacksmith.name: Blacksmith
Blacksmith.desc: If you have a weapon, your basic attack becomes Hone.
Blacksmith.desc2: If you have a weapon, your basic attack becomes Hone+.

Vampirism.name: Vampirism
Vampirism.desc2:
Your basic attack has lifesteal.
Your spells have 50% lifesteal.

OneWithNothing.name: One With Nothing
OneWithNothing.desc: If you end your turn with 0 mana, your Mana Regeneration is doubled.
OneWithNothing.desc2:
If you end your turn with 0 mana, your Mana Regeneration is doubled.
Bonus ability: Slit Wrists

BedBugs.name: Bed Bugs
BedBugs.desc: You start battles with 2 beefy leech familiars.
BedBugs.desc2: You start battles with 4 beefy leech familiars.

WormLord.name: Worm Lord
WormLord.desc: When you take damage, spawn a leech familiar.
WormLord.desc2:
When you take damage, spawn a leech familiar.
Your basic attack spawns leech familiars.

InfiniteRebirth.name: Infinite Rebirth
InfiniteRebirth.desc: At the end of each round, if there is a body on the map and you're downed, you respawn on that tile with 1 HP and +10 temporary Speed. If that body was a party member, you spawn with full HP instead.
InfiniteRebirth.desc2: At the end of each round, if there is a body on the map and you're downed, you respawn on that tile with 25% HP and +10 temporary Speed. If that body was a party member, you spawn with full HP instead.

SacrificialLamb.name: Sacrificial Lamb
SacrificialLamb.desc: When you're downed, allies gain All Stats Up and take an extra turn.
SacrificialLamb.desc2:
When you're downed, allies gain All Stats Up and take an extra turn.
You can't get injuries.

DeathIncarnate.name: Servus Mortem
DeathIncarnate.desc: Destroy a random non-boss enemy at the start of each battle.
DeathIncarnate.desc2: Destroy a random enemy at the start of each battle. If this hits a boss, deal 50 damage instead.

OffloadPain.name: Offload Pain
OffloadPain.desc: When you heal, deal 1 damage to each enemy.
OffloadPain.desc2: When you heal, deal 2 damage to each enemy and you gain +1 Thorns.

CambionConception.name: Cambion Conception
CambionConception.desc: When you're downed, spawn a demon kitten familiar.
CambionConception.desc2: When you're downed, spawn 2 demon kitten familiars.

Leechmother.name: Leech Mother
Leechmother.desc: Your basic attack spawns a leech familiar.
Leechmother.desc2: Your basic attack spawns a beefy leech familiar.

Infected.name: Infected
Infected.desc: When you down a unit, reanimate it with 50% HP.
Infected.desc2: When you down a unit, reanimate it with full HP.

LastGasp.name: Last Grasp
LastGasp.desc:
When you're downed, deal 6 damage to each enemy and heal 6 HP to all allies.
Bonus ability: Seppuku
LastGasp.desc2:
When you're downed, deal 10 damage to each enemy and heal 10 HP to all allies.
Bonus ability: Seppuku

RelentlessDead.name: Relentless Dead
RelentlessDead.desc: At the end of each round, spawn a zombie kitten familiar onto a random tile.
RelentlessDead.desc2: At the end of each round, spawn 2 zombie kitten familiars onto random tiles.

ChainsOfGuilt.name: Chains of Guilt
ChainsOfGuilt.desc: When an enemy downs you and it wasn't a boss, it joins your party permanently.
ChainsOfGuilt.desc2: When an enemy downs you and it wasn't a boss, it joins your party permanently. If it was a boss, inflict Stun 3 on it.

DarkPriest.name: Dark Priest
DarkPriest.desc: At the start of each battle, if you don't have a weapon, gain a temporary Soul Dagger weapon.
DarkPriest.desc2: At the start of each battle, if you don't have a weapon, gain a temporary Soul Dagger weapon. You can use your weapon action an extra time each turn.

Undeath.name: Undeath
Undeath.desc: When you're downed, reanimate each ally to 33% HP. (Once per battle.)
Undeath.desc2: When you're downed, reanimate each ally to max HP. (Once per battle.)

NumbingLeeches.name: Numbing Leeches
NumbingLeeches.desc: Your basic attack deals 0 damage but its status and hit effects are tripled.
NumbingLeeches.desc2:
Your basic attack deals 0 damage, but its status and hit effects are tripled.
Your basic attack inflicts Mana Leech.

EternalHealth.name: Eternal Health
EternalHealth.desc: Suffer only Jinxed when downed. When your party wins a battle, if you were downed, heal to full.
EternalHealth.desc2: Suffer only Jinxed when downed. When your party wins a battle, if you were downed, heal to full. Your body is indestructible. When you're downed, allies get +1 LUCK for each Jinxed injury you have.

Torpor.name: Torpor
Torpor.desc: While you're downed, your basic attack is Haunt. Your body gains +6 corpse HP.
Torpor.desc2: While you're downed, your basic attack is Haunt and your spells are Spook. Your body gains +6 corpse HP.

SoulBound.name: Soul Bond
SoulBound.desc: Your basic attack inflicts Soul Link.
SoulBound.desc2: Your basic attack inflicts Soul Link. Inflict Soul Link on a random enemy at the start of the battle.

Superstition.name: Superstition
Superstition.desc:
Your basic attack inflicts -1LUCK. 
When a unit damages you, inflict -1LUCK on it.
Superstition.desc2:
Your basic attack inflicts -1LUCK and has a 15% chance to inflict Fear.
When a unit damages you, inflict -1LUCK and a 15% to Fear on it.

ImmortalLeeches.name: Immortal Leeches
ImmortalLeeches.desc: When a unit you inflicted Leeches on dies or loses its leeches, your next basic attack inflicts that many additional leeches.
ImmortalLeeches.desc2:
When a unit you inflicted Leeches on dies or loses its leeches, your next basic attack inflicts that many additional leeches.
Your basic attack inflicts +1 leech.

CorpseConnoisseur.name: Corpse Connoisseur
CorpseConnoisseur.desc:
Start each battle with 2-3 corpses near you.
When you destroy a corpse, heal 2 HP and spawn a food pickup.
CorpseConnoisseur.desc2:
Start each battle with 3-4 corpses near you.
When you destroy a corpse, heal 8 HP and spawn a food pickup.

Parasitic.name: Parasitic
Parasitic.desc: When you gain health, spawn a leech familiar.
Parasitic.desc2: When you gain health, spawn a leech familiar. 50% of the time, spawn a beefy leech instead.

SpreadSorrow.name: Spread Sorrow
SpreadSorrow.desc: When you inflict a debuff to an enemy, inflict that same debuff on another random enemy.
SpreadSorrow.desc2: When you inflict a debuff to an enemy, inflict that same debuff on 2 other random enemies.

SuperCrow.name: Super Crow!
SuperCrow.desc: Your crow has its abilities upgraded.
SuperCrow.desc2: Your crow has its abilities upgraded… Twice!

NaturesGuidance.name: Nature's Guidance
NaturesGuidance.desc: Allied familiars are immune to damage from tiles, knockback, thorns, and trample.
NaturesGuidance.desc2:
Allied familiars are immune to damage from tiles, knockback, thorns, and trample.
Familiars you spawn gain +1 Holy Shield.

PoisonIvy.name: Poison Ivy
PoisonIvy.desc: You and familiar you spawn are Poisonous.
PoisonIvy.desc2: You and familiar you spawn have Poisonous 2.

Pathfinder.name: Pathfinder
Pathfinder.desc: Grass tiles are free to move through for you and familiars you spawn. Plant grass as you walk.
Pathfinder.desc2: Grass tiles are free to move through for you and familiars you spawn. Gain +1 HP when moving through grass tiles. Plant grass as you walk.

EmptyVessels.name: Empty Vessels
EmptyVessels.desc: Familiars you spawn have +3 Health Regeneration and +10 max health.
EmptyVessels.desc2: Familiars you spawn have +3 Health Regeneration and uncapped HP.

WildAnimals.name: Wild Animals
WildAnimals.desc: Familiars you spawn attack a random enemy within their range when they are spawned.
WildAnimals.desc2: Familiars you spawn attack a random enemy within their range when they're spawned, then they take an extra turn.

BarkSkin.name: Bark Skin
BarkSkin.desc:
+1 Brace.
When you take damage, you get +1 temporary Brace until the start of your next turn.
BarkSkin.desc2:
+1 Brace.
When you take damage, gain +2 temporary Brace and +2 temporary Thorns until the start of your next turn.

SoothingSong.name: Love Song
SoothingSong.desc: Your basic action has +2 area, and heals 1 additional HP.
SoothingSong.desc2: Your basic action has +2 area, and heals 2 additional HP. The Damage your basic action grants lasts until the end of the battle.

Teamwork.name: Teamwork
Teamwork.desc: When one of your familiars kills something, all allies get +1 Damage.
Teamwork.desc2: When one of your familiars kills something, all allies get +1 Damage and heal 5 health.

Bouquet.name: Bouquet
Bouquet.desc: Spawn a tall flower tile under you at the end of your turn.
Bouquet.desc2: Spawn tall flower tiles under and around you at the end of your turn.

GoodVibrations.name: Good Vibrations
GoodVibrations.desc: Allies have +1 Health Regeneration and +1 Mana Regeneration.
GoodVibrations.desc2: Allies have +2 Health Regeneration and +2 Mana Regeneration.

VersatileVocalist.name: Versatile Vocalist
VersatileVocalist.desc: Your basic action deals 1 damage to enemies, and inflicts temporary -1 Damage. Your basic attack wont apply debuffs to allies or buffs to enemies.
VersatileVocalist.desc2: Your basic action has +1 area, deals 1 damage to enemies, and inflicts temporary -1 Damage. Your basic attack wont apply debuffs to allies or buffs to enemies.

LikeAFish.name: Like a Fish
LikeAFish.desc:
Water tiles don't slow you down.
Gain +1 Holy Shield at the end of the turn if you're wet and have no Holy Shield.
Familiars you spawn also have this passive.
LikeAFish.desc2:
Water tiles don't slow you down.
Gain +1 Holy Shield at the end of the turn if you're wet and have no Holy Shield. Gain +1 Health Regeneration.
Familiars you spawn also have this passive.

Encore.name: Encore
Encore.desc: When you use a musical ability, refresh your basic action.
Encore.desc2: Your musical spells cost 1 less mana. When you use a musical ability, refresh your basic action.

SpecialFriends.name: Super Friends
SpecialFriends.desc: Familiars spawned by spells gain All Stats Up 2, but that spell gets disabled until the spawned familiars die.
SpecialFriends.desc2:
Familiars spawned by spells gain All Stats Up 2, but that spell gets disabled until the spawned familiars die.
Your spawning spells cost 50% less mana.

SneakAttack.name: Sneak Attack
SneakAttack.desc:
Your spells that spawn familiars cost -3 mana.
Familiars spawned by your spells gain +2 Damage and +2 Movement, but die after their first turn.
SneakAttack.desc2:
Your spells that spawn familiars cost -3 mana.
Familiars spawned by your spells gain +4 Damage and +4 Movement, but die after their first turn.

WildStyle.name: Wild Style
WildStyle.desc: The first time you shapeshift each turn, gain an extra turn.
WildStyle.desc2: The first time you shapeshift each turn, gain All Stats Up and an extra turn.

BuddySystem.name: Buddy System
BuddySystem.desc: When you lose DIVINESHIELD, your crow gains +1 DIVINESHIELD. When your crow loses DIVINESHIELD, gain +1 DIVINESHIELD.
BuddySystem.desc2: When you lose DIVINESHIELD, all your familiars gain +1 DIVINESHIELD. When your crow loses DIVINESHIELD, gain +1 DIVINESHIELD.

FlowerPower.name: Flower Power
FlowerPower.desc: Units on flower tiles have +2 STR and +2 Brace. When you move, plant flowers on the tile you moved from.
FlowerPower.desc2: Units on flower tiles have +2 STR and +2 Brace. When you move, plant flowers on all tiles you move through.

SuicideSquad.name: Suicide Squad
SuicideSquad.desc: Your controllable familiars gain Self Destruct as their bonus ability.
SuicideSquad.desc2: Your controllable familiars gain Self Destruct+ as their bonus ability.

Feral.name: Feral
Feral.desc: Your bonus ability is Feral Attack.
Feral.desc2: Your bonus ability is Feral Attack.

RapGod.name: Rap God
RapGod.desc: Your basic action also gives temporary +4 SPD.
RapGod.desc2: Your basic action also gives temporary +4 SPD, enemies gain Confusion 2 instead.

Animalistic.name: Animalistic
Animalistic.desc:
Familiars you spawn gain +2 Damage.
When you shapeshift, gain +1 Damage.
Animalistic.desc2:
Familiars you spawn gain +2 Damage and a Bonus Attack.
When you shapeshift, gain +1 Damage and refresh your basic attack.

Maestro.name: Maestro
Maestro.desc: Your musical spells cost 50% less mana.
Maestro.desc2:
Your musical spells cost 50% less mana.
When you use a musical spell, heal 1 HP and gain +1 to a random stat.

MegaMinions.name: Mega Minions
MegaMinions.desc: Every 3rd familiar you spawn is upgraded into a Champion.
MegaMinions.desc2:
The 1st and every 3rd familiar you spawn are upgraded into a Champion.
(The first familiar you spawn is likely your Crow.)

TakeAim.name: Take Aim
TakeAim.desc: Gain +1 range and damage at the start of each turn. You lose this when you move.
TakeAim.desc2: Gain +2 range and damage at the start of each turn. You lose this when you move.

TowerDefense.name: Tower Defense
TowerDefense.desc: When an enemy comes within range, shoot them for 1 damage.
TowerDefense.desc2: When an enemy comes within range, use your basic attack on them.

HuntersBoon.name: Hunter's Boon
HuntersBoon.desc: The first time you kill a unit each turn, gain 5 mana.
HuntersBoon.desc2: The first time you kill a unit each turn, restore all your mana.

BroodMother.name: Brood Mother
BroodMother.desc: Your familiars and units you charm gain +2 Damage and +5 HP.
BroodMother.desc2: Your familiars and units you charm gain +3 Damage, +10 HP, and inflict Poison.

TaintedMother.name: Tainted Mother
TaintedMother.desc: Your familiars and units you charm gain +4 SPD and inflict Poison and Bleed.
TaintedMother.desc2:
Your familiars and units you charm gain +4 SPD and inflict Poison and Bleed.
Start each battle with 4 fly familiars.

Quiver.name: Quiver
Quiver.desc: Save unused basic attacks for future turns.
Quiver.desc2:
Save unused basic attacks for future turns.
If you haven't attacked this battle, the number you save is doubled.

SplitShot.name: Split Shot
SplitShot.desc: Your basic attack has +1 area but deals 50% less damage.
SplitShot.desc2: Your basic attack has +2 area but deals 50% less damage.

Hazardous.name: Hazardous
Hazardous.desc: Tile damage and effects are doubled.
Hazardous.desc2:
Tile damage and effects are doubled.
Allies are immune to tile damage and effects.

ThornArrows.name: Thorn Arrows
ThornArrows.desc2: Your basic attack spawns brambles in an area.

Traps.name: Traps
Traps.desc:
Your basic attack spawns a bear trap if you shoot an empty tile.
Whenever one of your traps triggers, gain +2 DEX.
Traps.desc2:
Your basic attack spawns a bear trap if you shoot an empty tile.
Whenever one of your traps triggers, gain +2 DEX and +1 Bonus Attack.

CatchProjectiles.name: Catch Projectiles
CatchProjectiles.desc: 33% chance to block enemy projectiles and a 100% chance to block allied projectiles. If you block a projectile, gain +1 Bonus Attack.
CatchProjectiles.desc2: 50% chance to block enemy projectiles and a 100% chance to block allied projectiles. If you block a projectile, gain +1 Bonus Attack and +1 All Stats Up.

TrickyTraps.name: Tricky Traps
TrickyTraps.desc: Damage and effects from your traps are doubled.
TrickyTraps.desc2:
Damage and effects from your traps are doubled.
Allies don't trigger your traps.

GravityFalls.name: Gravity Falls
GravityFalls.desc: Your basic attack deals +1 damage for each tile you shoot beyond range 3.
GravityFalls.desc2:
+2 range.
Your basic attack deals +1 damage for each tile you shoot beyond range 3.

HawkEye.name: Bullseye
HawkEye.desc:
Your ranged attacks never miss.
+25% critical hit chance.
HawkEye.desc2:
Your ranged attacks never miss.
+25% critical hit chance.
Gain +1 LUCK each time you make a critical hit.

Spotters.name: Spotters
Spotters.desc: Your basic attack can target tiles adjacent to allies.
Spotters.desc2: Your basic attack and spells can target tiles adjacent to allies.

LuckSwing.name: Luck Swing
LuckSwing.desc: +50% critical hit chance but +25% chance to miss.
LuckSwing.desc2: +50% critical hit chance but +25% chance to miss.

Host.name: Host
Host.desc: Start each battle with 2 tiny spider familiars. A spider egg parasite is added to your inventory. You can unequip parasites freely.
Host.desc2: Start each battle with 2 tiny spider familiars. A spider webber parasite is added to your inventory. You can unequip parasites freely.

Sniper.name: Sniper
Sniper.desc: Critical hits deal +100% more damage and have a 25% chance to inflict Stun.
Sniper.desc2: Critical hits deal +200% more damage and have a 33% chance to inflict Stun.

RubberArrows.name: Rubber Arrows
RubberArrows.desc: Your projectiles bounce to another enemy within 3 tiles.
RubberArrows.desc2: Your projectiles bounce to another enemy within 4 tiles, twice!

TalkToAnimals.name: Talk to Animals
TalkToAnimals.desc: Your basic attack inflicts Charm 5 the first time you use it each battle.
TalkToAnimals.desc2:
Your basic attack inflicts Charm 5 the first time you use it each battle.
Your basic attack has a 25% chance to inflict Charm 1.

AnimalControl.name: Animal Control
AnimalControl.desc: Your basic attack causes units to immediately attack an enemy in range.
AnimalControl.desc2: Your basic attack causes units to immediately attack an enemy in range. Your basic attack can heal allies.

SleepDarts.name: Sleep Darts
SleepDarts.desc: At the start of each battle, you and all allies that don't have weapons gains a temporary Sleep Dart.
SleepDarts.desc2: At the start of each battle, you and all allies that don't have weapons gains a temporary Sleep Dart with 2 uses.

Survivalist.name: Survivalist
Survivalist.desc:
6 healing consumables and a full water bottle are added to your inventory.
You can use consumables on allies.
Store +2 food at the end of each battle.
Survivalist.desc2:
4 large healing consumables are added to your inventory.
You can use consumables on allies.
Store +20 food at the end of each battle.

Fleabag.name: Fleabag
Fleabag.desc: At the end of your turn, spawn Flea familiars equal to the number of enemies you've killed this battle.
Fleabag.desc2: At the end of your turn, spawn Flea familiars equal to the number of enemies you've killed this battle plus two.

ThrillOfTheHunt.name: Thrill of the Hunt
ThrillOfTheHunt.desc: At the end of each battle, if you killed at least 3 enemies, gain +1 DEX permanently and find a random consumable item.
ThrillOfTheHunt.desc2: At the end of each battle, if you killed at least 3 enemies, gain +1 DEX permanently and find a random consumable item. +1 Range and +1 Health Regeneration for every 5 DEX you have.

Thorns.name: Thorns
Thorns.desc2:
Thorns 4.
Gain +1 Thorns when you take damage.

HeavyHanded.name: Heavy Handed
HeavyHanded.desc2:
+3 Knockback Damage.
Your basic attack gains +3 Knockback.

SlackOff.name: Slack Off
SlackOff.desc: If you end your turn with unused movement actions, gain 8 HP.
SlackOff.desc2: If you end your turn with unused movement actions, gain +2 CON, 8 HP and 5 mana.

Scabs.name: Scabs
Scabs.desc: Gain +2 Shield when you take damage from an ability.
Scabs.desc2: Gain +2 Shield when you take damage from any source.

Plow.name: Plow
Plow.desc: When you knock back a unit, leave a rock where that unit was.
Plow.desc2:
When you knock back a unit, leave a rock where that unit was.
All damage you deal has +1 Knockback.

PetRocks.name: Pet Rocks
PetRocks.desc:
Rocks you spawn are alive!!
...and have +3 HP. Spawn a rock at the start of the battle.
PetRocks.desc2:
Rocks you spawn are alive, and hot!!
...and have +7 HP. Spawn a boulder at the start of the battle.

ToadStyle.name: Toad Style
ToadStyle.desc: Your movement action is a jump. Landing on a unit deals damage and displaces it.
ToadStyle.desc2: Your movement action is a jump. Landing on a unit deals damage and displaces it.

ChainKnockback.name: Chain Knockback
ChainKnockback.desc:
Your basic attack gains +1 Knockback.
Units you knockback will Knockback other units.
ChainKnockback.desc2:
Your basic attack gains +1 Knockback.
All knockback you deal is increased by 2 and deals +1 extra damage.
Units you knockback will Knockback other units further.

Wrestlemaniac.name: Wrestlemaniac
Wrestlemaniac.desc:
Your basic attack becomes Suplex when adjacent to enemies.
You gain the ability Toss.
Wrestlemaniac.desc2:
Your basic attack is Suplex while you're next to a unit that can be suplexed and Your basic attack becomes Suplex when adjacent to enemies. +1 Bonus Move.
You gain the ability Toss+.

MountainForm.name: Mountain Form
MountainForm.desc:
Knockback immunity.
Tiles you walk over become dirt and may spawn rocks.
MountainForm.desc2:
Trample. Knockback and Fire immunity.
Tiles you walk over become dirt and may spawn rocks.

HomeRun.name: Home Run
HomeRun.desc: Knockback you deal is increased by 10.
HomeRun.desc2: Knockback you deal is increased by 10 and inflicts Bruise 1.

RockAspect.name: Rock Aspect
RockAspect.desc: Units that attack or contact you have a 10% chance to get Petrified.
RockAspect.desc2: Units that attack or contact you have a 20% chance to get Petrified.

WideLoad.name: Wide Load
WideLoad.desc: When an adjacent ally is targeted by an enemy, swap places with the ally.
WideLoad.desc2: When an adjacent ally is targeted by an enemy, gain +1 temp Thorns and temp Brace, then swap places with the ally.

HardHead.name: Hard Head
HardHead.desc: You block attacks from the front.
HardHead.desc2: You block attacks from the front. Your basic attack inflicts Bruise.

MyLeg.name: My Leg!
MyLeg.desc:
All injuries you get are Broken Legs.
If you have four broken legs, gain +4 Thorns, Trample, and adjacent allies have Toss as a bonus ability.
MyLeg.desc2:
All injuries you get are Broken Legs.
If you have four broken legs, gain +4 Thorns, +4 Brace, Trample, and adjacent allies have Toss as a bonus ability.

Hardy.name: Hardy
Hardy.desc: Heal to full HP at the start of each battle.
Hardy.desc2: Heal to full HP at the start of each battle. +3 Health Regeneration.

SlowAndSteady.name: Slow and Steady
SlowAndSteady.desc: Gain -2 SPD and +1 Range at the end of each turn. If your SPD is 0, you can attack an extra time each turn.
SlowAndSteady.desc2: Gain -2 SPD, +1 Range, +1 STR, and +1 INT at the end of each turn. If your SPD is 0, you can attack an extra time each turn.

FollowUp.name: Follow Up
FollowUp.desc: After you use your basic attack, dash forward as far as you can.
FollowUp.desc2: After you use your basic attack, dash forward as far as you can and do a melee attack.

CatAPult.name: Cat-A-Pult
CatAPult.desc: You can throw adjacent allies up to 4 tiles on their turns without using their movement action.
CatAPult.desc2: You can throw adjacent allies to any tile on their turns without using their movement action.

ShovingMatch.name: Shoving Match
ShovingMatch.desc:
When you knock a unit into an ally, or knock an ally into an enemy, that ally uses their basic attack on the other unit.
Your basic attack has +1 Knockback.
ShovingMatch.desc2:
When you knock a unit into an ally, or knock an ally into an enemy, that ally uses their basic attack on the other unit.
Your basic attack has +2 Knockback. You deal no damage to allies.

Stoic.name: Stoic
Stoic.desc: If you end your turn with unused movement actions, gain +2 Bonus Moves.
Stoic.desc2: If you end your turn with unused movement actions, gain +2 Bonus Moves, +2 Shield and +1 Brace.

PriorityTarget.name: Priority Target
PriorityTarget.desc: Enemies will attack you instead of your allies if they can.
PriorityTarget.desc2: +2 Thorns, +2 Brace, and +2 Health Regeneration. Enemies will attack you instead of your allies if they can.

Bouncer.name: Bouncer
Bouncer.desc: When an ally takes damage, move 3 tiles toward the source of the damage and attack it if you can.
Bouncer.desc2: When an ally takes damage, full move toward the source of the damage and attack it if you can.

Flying.name: Antigravity
Flying.desc:
You have Flying Movement. When you use a Gravity element ability gain +1 SPD.
Gravity element spells cost -1 mana.
Flying.desc2:
You have Flying Movement. When you use a Gravity element ability gain +2 SPD.
Gravity element spells cost -2 mana.

SoulShatter.name: Soul Shatter
SoulShatter.desc: When you kill a unit, deal 1 damage to all enemies.
SoulShatter.desc2: When you kill a unit, deal 2 damage to all enemies.

Glow.name: Glow
Glow.desc2: All damage you deal inflicts Blind.

Blink.name: Blink
Blink.desc: 33% chance to teleport to a random tile when targeted by an enemy.
Blink.desc2: 50% chance to teleport to a random tile when targeted by an enemy.

FullPower.name: Full Power
FullPower.desc: While at full mana, your basic attack deals triple damage and has +3 Knockback.
FullPower.desc2:
While at full mana, your basic attack deals triple damage and has +3 Knockback.
Bonus Ability: Grow Head.

RealityShatter.name: Reality Shatter
RealityShatter.desc: Gravity element abilities spawn Floating Glass.
RealityShatter.desc2: Gravity element abilities spawn Floating Glass and inflict Bleed 1.

MentalStorm.name: Mental Storm
MentalStorm.desc: Gain +1 Charge when you cast a spell.
MentalStorm.desc2: Gain +2 Charge when you cast a spell.

Wither.name: Wither
Wither.desc: Gravity element abilities inflict a random negative status effect when used on enemies.
Wither.desc2: Gravity element abilities inflict a random negative status effect when used on enemies. When you inflict a negative status effect, inflict +1 of that status effect.

Flourish.name: Flourish
Flourish.desc: Gravity element abilities do not harm allies. Gravity element abilities give a random positive status effect when used on allies. When you inflict a positive status effect, inflict +1 of that status effect.
Flourish.desc2: Gravity element abilities do not harm allies. Gravity element abilities give a random positive status effect when used on allies. When you inflict a positive status effect, inflict +2 of that status effect.

PsySmack.name: Psy Smack
PsySmack.desc: Knockback damage you and your allies deal is doubled.
PsySmack.desc2: Knockback damage and distance you and your allies deal is doubled and has Chain Knockback.

Beckon.name: Beckon
Beckon.desc2: Your basic attack has +4 Knockback and Chain Knockback.

MindTempest.name: Mind Tempest
MindTempest.desc: After every sixth spell you cast, gain All Stats Up and +1 Magic Damage.
MindTempest.desc2: After every sixth spell you cast, gain All Stats Up, +1 Magic Damage, and reduce the cost of your spells by 1 mana.

Overflow.name: Overflow
Overflow.desc: While at full mana, gain +2 Brace and Flying Movement. Your mana is uncapped.
Overflow.desc2: While at full mana, gain +2 Brace and Teleportation. Your mana is uncapped.

Omniscience.name: Omniscience
Omniscience.desc: You can see EVERYTHING. Line of sight restrictions are ignored.
Omniscience.desc2: You can see EVERYTHING. Line of sight restrictions are ignored.

PsionicRepel.name: Psionic Repel
PsionicRepel.desc: Units that attack or contact you get knocked back 10 tiles.
PsionicRepel.desc2: Units that attack or contact you get knocked back 10 tiles and are Immobilized.

Enlightened.name: Enlightened
Enlightened.desc: While at full mana, the first spell you cast each turn is free.
Enlightened.desc2: While at full mana, all of your spells are free to cast once a turn.

MadVisage.name: Mad Visage
MadVisage.desc:
All injuries you get are Disfigured.
While at full mana, your basic action inflicts Madness.
While you have 0 or less CHA you can attack an additional time each turn.
MadVisage.desc2:
All injuries you get are Disfigured.
Units that contact or attack you get Madness.
While at full mana, your basic attack inflicts Madness.
While at 0 CHA you can attack 2 additional times each turn.

PowerUp.name: Power Up
PowerUp.desc: When you gain excess mana, gain +1 Magic Damage and +1 INT.
PowerUp.desc2: When you gain excess mana, gain +1 Magic Damage, +1 INT. and +1 DIVINESHIELD.

TrueSight.name: True Sight
TrueSight.desc: You and your allies can't miss enemies within your line of sight.
TrueSight.desc2: You and your allies can't miss enemies within your line of sight. Allied physical attacks gain +50% critical hit chance against those enemies.

Radiation.name: Braingeyser
Radiation.desc: When you gain excess mana, emit that many Sparkles.
Radiation.desc2: When you gain excess mana, emit that many Sparkles and remove all your debuffs.

GravityWell.name: Gravity Well
GravityWell.desc: When a unit is knocked through a tile adjacent to you, stop it and inflict Stun.
GravityWell.desc2: When a unit is knocked through a tile adjacent to you, stop it, inflict Stun and deal 5 damage to it.

Drag.name: Drag
Drag.desc: Units that you knockback take 1 damage for each tile they pass through.
Drag.desc2: Units that you knockback take 2 damage for each tile they pass through.

Twiddle.name: Twiddle
Twiddle.desc: Your basic attack deals 0 damage, but you can use it 2 additional times each turn.
Twiddle.desc2: Start each battle with +5 Bonus Attacks. Your basic attack deals 0 damage, but you can use it 2 additional times each turn.

RepressedMemories.name: Repressed Memories
RepressedMemories.desc: When you spend mana, cast a random Psychic spell that costs less than the mana spent.
RepressedMemories.desc2: When you spend mana, cast a random spell from any class that costs less than the mana spent.

EldritchVisage.name: Eldritch Visage
EldritchVisage.desc: At the start of your turn, inflict Magic Weakness 1 on all enemies in your line of sight.
EldritchVisage.desc2: At the start of your turn, inflict Magic Weakness 1 and Marked on all enemies in your line of sight.

Putrefy.name: Putrefy
Putrefy.desc2: Your basic attack inflicts permanent Rot.

NeverFull.name: Never Full
NeverFull.desc:
You can heal over your max HP.
Excess HP is lost between battles.
NeverFull.desc2:
You can heal over your max HP.
Excess HP is lost between battles.
Gain +1 STR for every 5 HP you have over max HP.

MainCourse.name: Supersize Me!
MainCourse.desc: Food and scrap pickups you spawn are bigger.
MainCourse.desc2: Food and scrap pickups you spawn are max size.

FreshMeat.name: Fresh Meat
FreshMeat.desc: When you eat food, gain +1 STR.
FreshMeat.desc2: When you eat food, gain +1 STR and +1 to a random stat.

Masochist.name: Masochist
Masochist.desc: When you take damage, gain +1 STR, CON, or SPD at random.
Masochist.desc2: When you take damage, you get +1 STR, CON, and SPD.

Glutton.name: Glutton
Glutton.desc: When a food pickup spawns within 2 tiles of you, move to it.
Glutton.desc2: When a food pickup spawns within 2 tiles of you, move to it with trample.

Hooked.name: Hooked
Hooked.desc: You can use your hook 2 additional times on your turn.
Hooked.desc2:
You can use your hook 2 additional times on your turn.
Your hook deals +1 damage and has Cleave.

Stompy.name: Stompy!
Stompy.desc:
You have Trample.
Trample damage you deal has Cleave.
Stompy.desc2:
You have Trample and +2 Bonus Moves.
Trample damage you deal has Cleave.

Barbed.name: Barbed
Barbed.desc: Your hook deals +1 damage and inflicts Bleed.
Barbed.desc2: Your hook deals +5 damage and inflicts Bleed.

GrapplingHook.name: Grappling Hook
GrapplingHook.desc: Your hook pulls you toward knockback-immune objects.
GrapplingHook.desc2: Your hook pulls you toward knockback-immune objects. Refresh your movement action when you use your hook.

PainGain.name: Rankle
PainGain.desc: When you take damage, gain +2 Temp Damage.
PainGain.desc2: When you take damage, gain +1 Damage and +1 Temp Damage.

WideSwing.name: Spin to Win
WideSwing.desc: Your basic attack is a 3x3 tile spin attack with Cleave.
WideSwing.desc2: Your basic attack is a 3x3 tile double spin attack with Cleave.

Confrontational.name: Confrontational
Confrontational.desc: When you take damage, trample one tile towards the source of damage.
Confrontational.desc2: When you take damage, trample all the way to the source of damage.

HeaveHook.name: Heave Hook
HeaveHook.desc:
Your hook can target tiles.
Units pulled by your hook gain trample while being hooked.
HeaveHook.desc2:
Your hook can target tiles.
Units pulled by your hook gain trample while being hooked, this trample damage is doubled.

Harpooner.name: Harpooner
Harpooner.desc: When an enemy moves in range, hook it.
Harpooner.desc2: When an enemy moves in range, hook it. Your hook deals +2 Damage.

LordOfTheFlies.name: Lord of the Flies
LordOfTheFlies.desc:
All flies are Charmed and get +1 Damage.
Whenever you inflict Rot, you inflict +1 Rot.
LordOfTheFlies.desc2:
All flies are Charmed and get +4 Damage.
Whenever you inflict Rot, you inflict +1 Rot.

Schadenfreude.name: Schadenfreude
Schadenfreude.desc: Your STR and CON are increased by 2 for each disorder your party has.
Schadenfreude.desc2: All of your stats are increased by 2 for each disorder your party has.

Gurgitator.name: Gurgitator
Gurgitator.desc: Whenever you heal over your max HP, gain +1 STR.
Gurgitator.desc2: Whenever you heal over your max HP, gain +1 STR and +1 Weapon Damage.

LooseMeat.name: Loose Meat
LooseMeat.desc: When you take damage, spawn a food pickup.
LooseMeat.desc2: When you take damage or move, spawn a food pickup.

Hack.name: Hack
Hack.desc:
Your basic attack is always critical against enemies with Shield.
Your basic attack's critical hits remove buffs from units.
Hack.desc2:
Your basic attack is always critical against enemies with Shield.
Your basic attack's critical hits remove buffs from units.
Your critical hits deal +100% damage.

BowlingBall.name: Bowling Ball
BowlingBall.desc: Adjacent and diagonal allied cats get the bonus ability Bowl.
BowlingBall.desc2: Adjacent and diagonal allied cats get the bonus ability Bowl+.

Testy.name: Testy
Testy.desc: When you take damage, gain +1 movement range until the end of your turn.
Testy.desc2: When you take damage, gain +1 movement range.

Indigestion.name: Indigestion
Indigestion.desc: Whenever you heal over your max HP, fart and inflict Poison 3 on adjacent units.
Indigestion.desc2: Whenever you heal over your max HP, fart and inflict Poison 3 and Burn 3 on adjacent units.

Incubator.name: Incubator
Incubator.desc: Whenever you heal over your max HP, spawn a rot fly.
Incubator.desc2: Whenever you heal over your max HP, spawn a rot fly with HP and damage equal to the excess healing.

DukeOfFlies.name: Duke of Flies
DukeOfFlies.desc:
At the end of the battle, all food pickups become allied flies.
Allied flies stay with you between battles.
DukeOfFlies.desc2:
At the end of the battle, all food pickups become allied flies.
Allied flies stay with you between battles.
Your basic attack spawns flies.

SelfAssured.name: Self-Assured
SelfAssured.desc: Gain a random stat up whenever you down a unit.
SelfAssured.desc2: Gain All Stats Up whenever you down a unit.

LuckDrain.name: Luck Drain
LuckDrain.desc: Gain +1 LUCK whenever a unit is downed.
LuckDrain.desc2:
Gain +1 LUCK whenever a unit is downed.
Gain an extra +2 LUCK whenever YOU down a unit.

Infested.name: Infested
Infested.desc: 50% chance to spawn a flea familiar when you end your turn.
Infested.desc2:
Spawn 2-3 fleas at the start of each battle.
50% chance to spawn a flea familiar when you end your turn.

Worms.name: Worms
Worms.desc: 50% chance to spawn a maggot familiar when you end your turn.
Worms.desc2: 50% chance to spawn a mutated maggot familiar when you end your turn.

Amped.name: Amped
Amped.desc: Gain +1 SPD at the end of your turn.
Amped.desc2:
Gain +1 SPD at the end of your turn.
You can move an extra time each turn.

Furious.name: Furious
Furious.desc:
Gain +1 Damage each time you land a critical hit.
+5% critical hit chance.
Furious.desc2:
Gain +1 Damage and +5% critical hit chance each time you land a critical hit.
+5% critical hit chance.

MetalDetector.name: Metal Detector
MetalDetector.desc: 5% chance to spawn a coin when you move over a tile.
MetalDetector.desc2: 10% chance to spawn a coin when you move over a tile.

DeathProof.name: Deathproof
DeathProof.desc: While downed, you have a 25% chance to revive with 1 HP at the end of each round.
DeathProof.desc2: While downed, you have a 33% chance to revive with 10 HP and All Stats Up at the end of each round.

Leader.name: Leader
Leader.desc: Adjacent allies have +1 Damage and +1 Range.
Leader.desc2: All allies have +1 Damage and +1 Range.

Mange.name: Mange
Mange.desc: Inflict Poison 1 on units that contact you.
Mange.desc2: Inflict 1 Poison, Bleed, Bruise, Weakness, and Leech on units that contact you.

ETank.name: E-Tank
ETank.desc: Start each battle with +20 unfilled max health.
ETank.desc2: Start each battle with +50 unfilled max health.

Careful.name: Careful
Careful.desc: Damage you deal to other allies is reduced to 0.
Careful.desc2:
Damage you deal to other allies is reduced to 0. You cannot inflict debuffs on other allies.
You are careful in many other ways too.

DirtyClaws.name: Dirty Claws
DirtyClaws.desc: Your physical attacks on Poisoned or Bleeding enemies inflict +1 Poison and/or Bleed.
DirtyClaws.desc2:
Your basic attack inflicts Poison 1 and Bleed 1. 
Your physical attacks on Poisoned or Bleeding enemies inflict +1 Poison and/or Bleed.

LateBloomer.name: Late Bloomer
LateBloomer.desc: On your 5th turn, you gain All Stats Up 3.
LateBloomer.desc2: On your 3rd turn, you gain All Stats Up 3.

Study.name: Study
Study.desc: Gain +1 INT whenever you hit a new type of unit with an attack or ability.
Study.desc2: Gain +1 INT whenever you hit a new type of unit with an attack or ability. All enemies of that type become Marked.

SkillShare.name: Skill Share
SkillShare.desc: Your other passive ability is shared with the other cats in your party at the start of each battle.
SkillShare.desc2: Your other passive ability is shared with the other cats in your party at the start of each battle. When breeding, your children will always inherit your other passive.

NaturalHealing.name: Natural Healing
NaturalHealing.desc2:
You have +2 Health Regeneration
Adjacent allies gain +1 Health Regeneration

LongShot.name: Longshot
LongShot.desc2:
+2 Range.
Your ranged attacks have +25% critical hit chance.

FastFooted.name: Fast Footsies
FastFooted.desc: You are immune to negative tile effects.
FastFooted.desc2:
You are immune to negative tile effects.
You can move through units and objects.

Pulp.name: Pulp
Pulp.desc: When you kill a unit or destroy a corpse, it becomes meat.
Pulp.desc2:
+4 Damage.
When you kill a unit or destroy a corpse, it becomes meat.

Amplify.name: Amplify
Amplify.desc2: +1 Magic Damage for every 3 CHA you have.

DeathBoon.name: Death Boon
DeathBoon.desc: When you're downed, all allies gain All Stats Up.
DeathBoon.desc2: When you're downed, all allies gain All Stats Up 2.

SantaSangre.name: Santa Sangre
SantaSangre.desc: When you're downed, allies heal 12 HP. Excess healing is converted to Shield.
SantaSangre.desc2: When you're downed, allies heal 20 HP. Excess healing is converted to Shield.

Untouched.name: Unscarred
Untouched.desc: While at full hp you have 100% critical hit chance.
Untouched.desc2: While at full hp you have 100% critical hit chance, +5 Mana Regeneration and +1 All Stats Up.

Daunt.name: Daunt
Daunt.desc2:
Small enemies won't attack you.
Inflict Fear 1 on units that contact or attack you.

AnimalHandler.name: Animal Handler
AnimalHandler.desc: You start each battle with a random vermin familiar with boosted damage and health.
AnimalHandler.desc2: You start each battle with 3 random vermin familiars with boosted damage and health.

WhipCracker.name: Whipcracker
WhipCracker.desc: When you damage an ally they gain +1 Damage.
WhipCracker.desc2: When you damage an ally they gain +1 Damage and +1 SPD.

PressurePoints.name: Might of the Meek
PressurePoints.desc: Damage you deal that's 2 or less is always critical.
PressurePoints.desc2: Damage you deal that's 3 or less is always critical. +50% Crit Damage.

Gassy.name: Gassy
Gassy.desc: Whenever you take damage, knock back all adjacent units.
Gassy.desc2: Whenever you take damage, poison all adjacent units and knock them back 10 tiles.

Dealer.name: Dealer
Dealer.desc: You can use consumables on other units.
Dealer.desc2:
You can use consumables on other units.
Consumables you use have double the effect.

Patience.name: Patience
Patience.desc: If you end your turn without taking any actions, gain an extra turn at the end of the round. You don't regenerate mana on your main turn if you pass it.
Patience.desc2: If you end your turn without taking any actions, gain an extra turn at the end of the round.

Wiggly.name: Wiggly
Wiggly.desc2: +25% dodge chance and +25% critical hit chance.

MiniMe.name: Mini-Me
MiniMe.desc: Gain a half-sized copy of yourself that has 50% of your stats. The copy is AI controlled.
MiniMe.desc2: Gain a half-sized copy of yourself that has 50% of your stats and quarter-sized copy that has 25% of your stats. The copies are AI controlled.

Unrestricted.name: Unrestricted
Unrestricted.desc: Actions with a once per battle restriction can be cast once per turn instead.
Unrestricted.desc2:
Actions with a once per battle restriction can be cast once per turn instead.
Actions with a once per turn restriction have a 50% chance to be castable again.

DeathsDoor.name: Death's Door
DeathsDoor.desc: While you're at 1 HP, your spells cost 1 mana, but can only be cast once per turn.
DeathsDoor.desc2: While you're at 5 or fewer HP, your spells cost 1 mana, but can only be cast once per turn.

OverConfident.name: Overconfident
OverConfident.desc: While at full HP, reduce the cost of your spells by 2, but take double damage. This can't reduce mana costs to less than 1.
OverConfident.desc2: While at full HP, reduce the cost of your spells by 2, but take double damage. This can't reduce mana costs to less than 1. When you cast a spell, heal 1 HP.

SerialKiller.name: Serial Killer
SerialKiller.desc: After you kill 3 units, gain +6 SPD and backstabs have 100% crit chance.
SerialKiller.desc2: After you kill 3 units, gain +6 SPD, backstabs have 100% crit chance, and gain an extra basic attack each turn.

StrengthInNumbers.name: Strength in Numbers
StrengthInNumbers.desc: Your familiars have +1 Damage for each other familiar you have.
StrengthInNumbers.desc2: You and your familiars have +1 Damage for each other familiar you have.

FightersSoul.name: Fighter's Soul
FightersSoul.desc: Fighter abilities are offered when you level up.
FightersSoul.desc2: Fighter abilities are offered when you level up.

HuntersSoul.name: Hunter's Soul
HuntersSoul.desc: Hunter abilities are offered when you level up.
HuntersSoul.desc2: Hunter abilities are offered when you level up.

MagesSoul.name: Mage's Soul
MagesSoul.desc: Mage abilities are offered when you level up.
MagesSoul.desc2: Mage abilities are offered when you level up.

ClericsSoul.name: Cleric's Soul
ClericsSoul.desc: Cleric abilities are offered when you level up.
ClericsSoul.desc2: Cleric abilities are offered when you level up.

TanksSoul.name: Tank's Soul
TanksSoul.desc: Tank abilities are offered when you level up.
TanksSoul.desc2: Tank abilities are offered when you level up.

ThiefsSoul.name: Thief's Soul
ThiefsSoul.desc: Thief abilities are offered when you level up.
ThiefsSoul.desc2: Thief abilities are offered when you level up.

MonksSoul.name: Monk's Soul
MonksSoul.desc: Monk abilities are offered when you level up.
MonksSoul.desc2: Monk abilities are offered when you level up.

ButchersSoul.name: Butcher's Soul
ButchersSoul.desc: Butcher abilities are offered when you level up.
ButchersSoul.desc2: Butcher abilities are offered when you level up.

DruidsSoul.name: Druid's Soul
DruidsSoul.desc: Druid abilities are offered when you level up.
DruidsSoul.desc2: Druid abilities are offered when you level up.

TinkerersSoul.name: Tinkerer's Soul
TinkerersSoul.desc: Tinkerer abilities are offered when you level up.
TinkerersSoul.desc2: Tinkerer abilities are offered when you level up.

NecromancersSoul.name: Necromancer's Soul
NecromancersSoul.desc: Necromancer abilities are offered when you level up.
NecromancersSoul.desc2: Necromancer abilities are offered when you level up.

PsychicsSoul.name: Psychic's Soul
PsychicsSoul.desc: Psychic abilities are offered when you level up.
PsychicsSoul.desc2: Psychic abilities are offered when you level up.

Charming.name: Charming
Charming.desc: You have a 25% chance to inflict Charm on units that damage you.
Charming.desc2: You have a 40% chance to inflict Charm on units that damage you.

FirstImpression.name: First Impression
FirstImpression.desc: Start each battle with +1 Bonus Attack.
FirstImpression.desc2: Start each battle with +2 Bonus Attacks and +2 Bonus Moves.

Scavenger.name: Scavenger
Scavenger.desc: If your trinket slot is empty, equip a small consumable food item at the start of each battle.
Scavenger.desc2: If your trinket slot is empty, equip a big consumable food item at the start of each battle.

ZenkaiBoost.name: Zenkai Boost
ZenkaiBoost.desc: If you end battle with 1 HP, gain +1 to a random stat permanently and start the next battle at full HP with All Stats Up 3.
ZenkaiBoost.desc2: If you end battle with 1 HP, gain +1 to 3 random stats permanently and start the next battle at full HP with All Stats Up 3.

Rockin.name: Rockin'
Rockin.desc: Spawn 4 small rocks at the start of each battle.
Rockin.desc2: Spawn 4 small rocks and 4 boulders at the start of each battle.

Mania.name: Mania
Mania.desc: 10% chance to restore all your mana at the start of your turn.
Mania.desc2: 25% chance to restore all your mana at the start of your turn.

OneEighty.desc: When you use your basic attack, turn around and use it again.
OneEighty.desc2:
When you use your basic attack, turn around and use it again.
Your basic attack inflicts Confusion 1.

JestersSoul.name: Jester's Soul
JestersSoul.desc:
Abilities from any class are offered when you level up.
You can reroll your level up options twice.
JestersSoul.desc2:
Abilities from any class are offered when you level up.
You can reroll your level up options twice.

HotBlooded.name: Hot-Blooded
